about.introduction: Hi, I'm Sylvio, an ICT student at Fontys in Eindhoven, heading into my internship semester. I focus on frontend and web development because I love building things that actually make sense and help people. To get there, I let my creativity and intuition guide me.
about.aiStance: AI teaches me. It doesn't build for me. I solve things myself first, ask for explanations when I'm stuck, and never ship code I don't understand. Slower, maybe. But it's mine.
about.beyondCode: Outside of code, you'll probably find me playing Overwatch or hitting my daily step goal while playing Pokémon Go. I collect Pokémon cards, listen to music on vinyl whenever I can, and film and edit little daily vlogs for my friends. Iced coffee is basically a personality trait at this point. I'm a winter person stuck in a summer world. Skiing whenever I get the chance and hibernating the rest of the time.
